items.title: Serbia's veteran ruler Vučić concedes election to student-led protest movement
items.summary: The populist right-wing leader of 12 years says it is "clear" his party has lost the vote billed as a referendum on the country's future.

items.title: Deeply divided Israel braces for pivotal election
items.summary: After three years of regional war, this is a battle Israel always knew was coming, writes Lucy Williamson.

items.title: Venezuelan opposition leader María Machado returns after months in exile
items.summary: Machado had left the country just a month before the US government seized Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro.

items.title: Musk says SpaceX restricted Ukraine's Starlink connection as service restored
items.summary: The tech billionaire accuses Ukraine of violating its terms of service by using the network for military activity.

items.title: Suspect in deadly Paris suburb shooting sent for psychiatric observation
items.summary: He will be observed to evaluate whether his "psychiatric health is compatible with pursuing his interrogation", authorities said.

items.title: Israel to close West Bank crossings on election day as crackdown escalates
items.summary: The Israeli Defense Forces announces restrictions on the movement of Palestinian workers in the run-up to Tuesday's election.
